title: Why build when you can download?

cues.en: I'm going to make this a short lecture because the conclusion is very simple.
cues.zh: 這一講會很短，因為結論很簡單。

cues.en: I do not recommend building your own model from scratch, except in the context of this course, and
cues.zh: 不建議從零建立自己的模型，除了本課程，或

cues.en: maybe also other courses or books where you are learning about the architecture and mechanisms of LMS.
cues.zh: 其他學習 LLM 架構與機制的課程、書籍。

cues.en: Here's the thing building a model from scratch is tedious.
cues.zh: 原因是，從零建立模型很繁瑣，

cues.en: It's time consuming, and you're likely to make simple mistakes just because there's so many moving
cues.zh: 很花時間，也容易犯簡單錯誤，因為 LLM 有太多互相配合的

cues.en: parts in an LLM, so many lines of code, multiple classes and methods and et cetera, et cetera.
cues.zh: 部分、程式行、類別與方法等等。

cues.en: Furthermore, if you build a model from scratch, that means it's untrained and the weights are randomized.
cues.zh: 而且，從零建的模型還沒訓練，權重是隨機的。

cues.en: And again, pre-training LMS is tedious and time consuming.
cues.zh: 預訓練 LLM，同樣繁瑣又費時。

cues.en: You have to make sure you're using an appropriate and big enough data set.
cues.zh: 必須確保資料集適當，而且夠大。

cues.en: And it can be very expensive in terms of time and also in terms of Costs, and as the model size grows
cues.zh: 時間與金錢成本，都可能很高；隨模型與

cues.en: and the data set size grows, these costs can become really significant.
cues.zh: 資料集增大，成本可能非常可觀。

cues.en: For example, training GPT three from scratch costs around 10 million USD.
cues.zh: 例如，從零訓練 GPT-3，大約花一千萬美元。

cues.en: So if you can afford to just toss around 10 million to train a model for fun, then congratulations!
cues.zh: 如果能隨手花一千萬，只為了好玩，訓練模型，恭喜，

cues.en: You are very lucky.
cues.zh: 你非常幸運。

cues.en: Now, training much smaller models can be cheaper and faster, but the small models just don't perform very well for practical purposes.
cues.zh: 更小模型，訓練可以更便宜、更快，但實務表現不太好。

cues.en: And yeah, that's basically the point here.
cues.zh: 這基本上就是重點。

cues.en: In fact, we are going to pre-train a small version of GPT two in the next section of the course.
cues.zh: 下一章，會預訓練一個小型 GPT-2，

cues.en: But you can't really do a lot of useful stuff with that model.
cues.zh: 但它其實做不了太多有用的事。

cues.en: So the point here is that building and training a model from scratch is a giant headache and can be very expensive.
cues.zh: 所以，從零建模與訓練，非常麻煩，也可能很昂貴。

cues.en: In contrast, there are literally hundreds of pre-trained models that you can download for free And
cues.zh: 相較之下，有數百個預訓練模型，可免費下載，

cues.en: these models that you can download for free are way better than the ones that we are going to build and train in this and the next section.
cues.zh: 而且遠比這一章與下一章，自己建立、訓練的模型好。

cues.en: So why would you ever actually build an LLM from scratch?
cues.zh: 那為什麼還要從零建立 LLM？

cues.en: It's a fair question, considering literally the entire purpose of this section of the course is to build a GPT from scratch.
cues.zh: 問得合理，畢竟這一章的整個目的，就是從零建立 GPT。

cues.en: Here's the thing.
cues.zh: 是這樣的，

cues.en: If you really want to understand the transformer architecture and the attention mechanism, you know
cues.zh: 如果真的想理解 Transformer 架構與注意力機制，

cues.en: you can watch some slick, high production YouTube videos or skim through a couple of blog posts, but you're never really going to get it.
cues.zh: 可以看製作精美的 YouTube 影片，或快速瀏覽幾篇部落格，但不會真正弄懂。

cues.en: Even if you read a bunch of academic technical papers, I still think you really won't understand how these models work and how they are put together.
cues.zh: 即使讀很多學術技術論文，我仍認為，你不會真的理解運作與組成方式。

cues.en: On the other hand, I very strongly believe that if you take the time to build a model from scratch,
cues.zh: 但我非常相信，如果花時間從零建模，

cues.en: slowly working your way up from something very simple to a full GPT two, then that is really just the
cues.zh: 從很簡單的東西，逐步做到完整 GPT-2，這真的就是

cues.en: best way to learn about LLM architectures and mechanisms.
cues.zh: 學習 LLM 架構與機制，最好的方法。

cues.en: And certainly for this course, it's not just about copy pasting code.
cues.zh: 而本課程，當然不只是複製貼上程式，

cues.en: It's about experimenting with and playing with code and exploring code, solving problems and working through exercises.
cues.zh: 而是實驗、玩程式、探索、解題，並完成練習。

cues.en: I think this is really just an amazing educational opportunity, and it's really the best way to learn.
cues.zh: 我覺得，這是很棒的學習機會，也是最好的學習方式。

cues.en: So the conclusion here is I do not recommend building an LLM from scratch to actually use.
cues.zh: 所以，結論是，不建議為了實際使用，從零建立 LLM。

cues.en: You would only use it for educational purposes, of course.
cues.zh: 主要用於教學目的，當然，

cues.en: You know, maybe there's exceptions.
cues.zh: 也許有例外。

cues.en: Maybe after taking this course you go to work for an AI company and you actually will be developing and building and training models from scratch.
cues.zh: 例如上完課，去 AI 公司工作，真的會從零開發、建立、訓練模型。

cues.en: But that's the very unusual exception.
cues.zh: 但那是很不常見的例外。

cues.en: Anyway, this is just something to keep in mind as you're working through the next couple of sections.
cues.zh: 接下來幾章，請記住這點。

cues.en: I hope you enjoy building an LLM from scratch, possibly for the first and hopefully for the last time in your life.
cues.zh: 希望你享受從零建立 LLM，也許人生第一次，也希望是最後一次。
